description.narrative: The overall goal with our support to public organisations is to ensure an enabling trade environment that promotes imports, exports, and investments. This requires functioning institutions for trade policy or EU integration. The activities include capacity-building activities such as technical training in various trade-related topics, support in the EU accession process, in preparing for negotiations and implementation of trade agreements, and in improving governance and coordination.

16.6 - Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.

17.10 - Främja ett universellt, regelbaserat, öppet, icke-diskriminerande och rättvist multilateralt handelssystem inom ramen för Världshandelsorganisationen, inklusive genom att slutföra förhandlingarna enligt utvecklingsagendan från Doha.

17.10 - Promote a universal, rules-based, open, non-discriminatory and equitable multilateral trading system under the World Trade Organization, including through the conclusion of negotiations under its Doha Development Agenda.
